description: Get the App Store top free chart for a country, in chart order with #1 first: the overall chart by default, or one category via category_id (see get_categories). Each app comes with its position, previous position, name, developer, rating and revenue and download estimates, and the response gives the chart day it describes. Only top free is collected; top paid and top grossing are not. Use get_ranking_history for how one app's position moved over time.

category_id.description: App Store category ID (default: "36", the overall chart; e.g. "6015" for Finance, "6014" for Games). get_categories lists them.

chart.description: Which chart. Only top_free is collected (top paid and top grossing are not, and return no items), so this is the default and the only option.

name: get_rankings
title: Get top chart rankings
